svg.text: LOCAL SERVER demo.py (Python · loopback only · Host/Origin/token checks)
Source queue: Craigslist → Facebook Marketplace → Redfin → Zillow (one tab each, in order)
snapshot.js → indexed table of visible elements (role, name, value)
ONE TypeSafe call → which operation + a target for each operation
only for TYPE_TEXT → a small text LLM writes the field value
re-check URL, form values, target, geometry, click occlusion
execute over CDP — a browser mutation is never retried
record the action, observe again … until DONE or BLOCKED
target = index of a seen element,
Bot check · sign-in wall · rate limit → report it, keep listings, next source
Read-only: never solves CAPTCHAs, messages sellers or enters credentials
